inference.cfo_channel_tail_interpretation: Each event is at least one block in the independent channel exceeding the listed absolute-error threshold; the exact bound is conservative and conditional on blocks_per_channel. It supplements pooled block P95/max criteria and is not a separate acceptance threshold.
inference.unit: independently seeded synthetic channel; blocks are nested within channel

experiment.inference_scope: the declared seeded synthetic channel family only
experiment.scope: synthetic 6-RB/30-kHz CPU PUSCH over independently seeded static two-path channels; combined IQ imbalance, Wiener phase noise, CFO, integer timing and AWGN receiver fixture with one CP-derived timing/CFO estimate shared over repeated blocks in each channel cluster, using fixed timing and family-maximum CFO guards without per-channel path truth; not deployment qualification or a field BLER estimate

interpretation.criterion_scope: This verdict applies only to the declared deterministic synthetic CPU fixture.
